before: Detaching an editor tore down its surface and released the collaboration replica; attaching again remounted from saved bytes and re-attached the replica as a fresh session.
after: Detaching parks the surface with its session and replica still attached, so remote edits keep applying; attaching, including into another window, moves the same surface without re-attaching.
reason: Shared data, operations, presence payloads and the update protocol are unchanged. Only when a local participant is mounted changes, and its replica stays attached through a move instead of being re-created.
